newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling weakens against the dollar.

text.p: NAIROBI- Oct 8 ( REUTER )- The Kenya shilling lost ground marginally against the dollar on Tuesday amid renewed importer demand in a calm market, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 56.00 against the dollar from 55.97 on Monday. On the pound, the shilling was posted at an average of 87.53 from 87.58 on Monday.
"Modest importer demand helped support the dollar as the market traded within a narrow band," a dealer said. "Trade was moderate with the 55.95/05 level holding out for most of the day."
"Today could herald renewed shilling strength as the tea and coffee exporters sell dollars to the market," she said. "The range for the day is spread between 56.15 and 55.85."
Commenting on the range, a commercial banker said that the shilling would most likely resist at the 56 level with a lot of government buying at the same level.
Dealers said overnight money market rates rose to between 15 and 20 levels.
